item.text: This checkout is Navidrome, and it has no `internal/storage/fs/oci` tree or `storagefs` package. I’ll keep the change scoped to the AlbumGrid artwork issue. The square option needs to reach the resized artwork reader so its cache key and output differ from the original shape.

The backend now carries the square flag into image resizing and cache keys, and the album grid requests square covers. I added a focused test for a rectangular JPEG becoming a square PNG while the regular resized version keeps its shape and format. I’ll format the Go files and run the relevant tests.
